results.label: this tree ships the plan gate (src/bots/plan-gate.js) (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
the probe measures a real sample of analyses rather than one hand-built case
not one candidate’s score, grade or price geometry is moved by attaching a plan
and no veto appears that is not a plan sentence (the gate adds only its own refusals)
every fact in the documented vocabulary is resolved to met/refused/unknown by a REAL run — none is dead weight
and each of the boolean facts is genuinely resolvable to a known value (met somewhere, refused or met elsewhere)
the graded and numeric facts resolve to known values too (a gate that always says unknown gates nothing)
the parent really does NOT consult a plan (negative control is non-vacuous)
with no plan attached, every candidate field, veto, grade, score, price and level is identical to the committed parent
the ONLY new candidate key is `plan_rules`, and it is null when no plan was consulted
a candidate the committed engine genuinely trades is measured, so a refusal below is attributable
the same candidate that is tradeable with no plan is REFUSED by a plan rule it cannot meet
the refusal is the FIRST thing the action line says (the trader’s own instruction leads)
and it is an ordinary `no_trade` entry, so the verdict, the Now guards and Copy plan obey it
the verdict of the one-plan run never substitutes the refused side
a rule the candidate MEETS leaves it tradeable and its grade, score and levels untouched
a plan of prose plus one unrecognised `require` line refuses nothing
and the payload reports the prose and the unrecognised line separately, so silence is impossible
the candidate carries no plan_rules block when the plan has no machine-checkable rule
an unreadable killzone (M8’s short-series sentinel) leaves both window rules UNKNOWN and refuses nothing
and the filter block says so, so a client can distinguish "not read" from "met"
an unreadable news calendar can neither satisfy nor fail a no-news requirement
a candidate with no computed levels reports an UNKNOWN reward:risk rather than a zero one
a directional requirement is evaluated per candidate side, so one can meet it while the other does not
and the timeframe rule is met on a 15m analysis, proving the fact reads the setup’s entry frame

scope: M56 engine: a written plan refuses a candidate at the decision surface, and only that: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock, a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser and a patched market module for the thrown-read path; M111 calendar-read states (blocked/clear/unknown), no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
